title: Tidal aperture
description: Five offset photographic windows widen and align into a single coastal panorama.
useCase: Turn a small photographic fragment into a full image through a reversible reveal.
interaction: Scroll, drag upward, scrub the aperture slider or choose Open view.
reducedMotion: Programmatic opening is immediate and image zoom is removed; direct scrolling and scrubbing remain available.
limitations: One local image and a bounded internal scroll area; no global scroll controller or video playback.
look: Saturated vermilion field with a heavy dark-brown sans wordmark beside a stepped column of aerial surf photo slices; thin slider and outlined button below.
motion: Scroll, drag or slider progress reversibly widens five stacked clip-path bands, centre first with smoothstep easing, into one full-bleed photo while it zooms out and the title lifts and fades.
adapt: Geometry lives in `draw`: each `.ta-window` gets a `clipPath` inset from `amount`, sized by `apertureWidth` and staggered by distance from the centre window; `.ta-track` height sets the scroll length. Replace the photo and `.ta-title` wordmark; `seek` routes the slider, drag and button.
